chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, who said:
I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) sitting in his house, at the door of his house, facing the Ka'bah.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, a title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq

ai.seo_question: What was the posture and orientation of Imam al-Sadiq when sitting in his home?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) practice of facing the Ka'bah while seated in his home, a posture known as *istiqbal al-Ka'bah*. In Shia scholarly tradition, this act is viewed as a voluntary expression of reverence (*ta'zim*) and spiritual connection to the House of God, distinct from the obligatory direction of prayer (*qibla*). It underscores the importance of maintaining a sacred orientation even in private, domestic spaces.

en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hammad Bin Usman who said,
‘I saw Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> sit in his<sup>asws</sup> house by the door of his house, facing the Qiblah’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman who has said the following: “
Once, I saw abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) sitting in his house near the door facing the Ka’bah.”
